cover_letter:
Dear Replika team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Writer role. What struck me about Replika is the intention behind your AI: helping people flourish in real life, not just become a better version of themselves. That's a story worth telling well, and I'd like to help tell it.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, working where SEO, content, and web meet. I build and optimize websites for traditional and AI-powered search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate the repetitive work. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress, publishing and updating pages and blog posts. On my own projects, I've built and optimized sites like mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and running technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised search health.

I write for search without writing for robots. I use AI tools daily—Claude, ChatGPT—for research, content, and audits, but my writing stays human. I'm comfortable in Search Console, Ahrefs, and Semrush, and I can interview someone and turn the conversation into a story worth reading. I'm fast and reliable, and I proactively hunt for stories and use cases rather than waiting for a brief.

User stories are the heart of this role. I understand the care needed to get them right—true, specific, respectful. I'd love to bring my mix of SEO, content, and technical skills to Replika and help your website and blog tell the story they deserve.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
